summary: Join training on sustainable practices in the oil and gas industry. Learn to implement eco-friendly strategies and drive positive change in your organization.
lede: Sustainability in oil and gas brings environmental, social and governance considerations into exploration, production and asset management. For operations, engineering, ESG and environmental professionals, the course addresses practical ways to measure emissions and reduce operational impacts. Participants learn to calculate carbon intensity, design methane leak detection and repair programs, and develop water-management plans and ESG disclosures.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with integrating sustainability into the core of oil and gas operations, from the wellhead to the boardroom.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in oil and gas operations, HSE, or corporate reporting. A basic understanding of environmental regulations and general industry terminology is required. No prior experience with ESG frameworks is necessary, though familiarity with ISO standards is beneficial.
